contribute.correctionBody: Tell maintainers what should be corrected and include a link to the public source whenever possible. Do not submit private information or urgent emergency requests through this issue channel.
contribute.correctionStep1: Describe the specific page, record, or sentence that needs review.
contribute.correctionStep2: Include the official source URL and the date you checked it.
contribute.correctionStep3: Explain what changed without including confidential personal information.
contribute.developerBody: Review the architecture, data provenance, tests, and contribution rules before opening a pull request. Small, reviewable changes are easier for community maintainers to verify.

about.missionBody: BetterLimay is an independent, volunteer-built portal that makes public information about Limay easier to find, understand, and verify.
about.independenceBody: BetterLimay is not the official website of the Municipality of Limay and does not speak for the LGU. Verify important information with the original government source.
about.sourcesBody: Published facts carry source, retrieval, and verification metadata. When a source is unavailable, the portal shows the gap instead of filling it with an assumption.

portal.title: Independent portal
portal.body: BetterLimay is a community project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by the Municipality of Limay.

sources.title: Source responsibility
sources.body: Use the linked original source to confirm current requirements, schedules, officials, legal records, and emergency information.

contact.title: Corrections and contact
contact.body: Use the contribution route to suggest a correction or review the public source code and issue tracker.

collection.title: What the portal collects
collection.body: Browsing does not require an account. The report form asks only for the contact details and description needed to process a report, plus consent and security fields.

use.title: How information is used
use.body: Report information is intended only for the configured delivery provider when the service is enabled. Report text is not sent to client analytics.

retention.title: Retention and provider handling
retention.body: The delivery provider, retention period, deletion process, and access procedure must be documented before report delivery is enabled. Until then, the form does not send reports.

rights.title: Your privacy questions
rights.body: For a privacy concern or correction request, use the public contribution channel and do not include sensitive personal information in an issue.

independence.title: Independent information
independence.body: BetterLimay is a volunteer community portal, not an official LGU publication. Its pages do not create an official obligation, approval, or service guarantee.

verification.title: Verify before relying
verification.body: Check the linked source for current fees, requirements, deadlines, officials, legal documents, project status, and urgent instructions.

links.title: External links
links.body: Links to official or third-party websites are provided for verification and may change outside the portal's control.

changes.title: Changes to the portal
changes.body: Community maintainers may update pages, source notes, and route availability as public evidence changes.

commitment.title: Accessibility commitment
commitment.body: The portal aims for WCAG 2.1 AA practices: semantic landmarks, keyboard operation, visible focus, readable contrast, text alternatives, and reduced-motion support.

features.title: Current features
features.body: Charts have visible table alternatives, maps have list alternatives, and source states do not rely on color alone.

feedback.title: Report an accessibility barrier
feedback.body: Use the contribution route to describe the page, control, device, and assistive technology involved. Please do not include sensitive personal information.

independent.title: Is BetterLimay official?
independent.body: No. It is an independent community portal and is not affiliated with the Municipality of Limay.

sources.title: Where does information come from?
sources.body: Published records link to public government or other original sources and show retrieval and verification details.

unverified.title: Why are some details missing?
unverified.body: A missing or unverified record means the maintainers could not safely confirm it from a reachable public source.

report.title: Does the report form send information?
report.body: Not yet. Delivery remains disabled until server-side security, rate limiting, privacy operations, and an approved delivery provider are configured.

transparency.explainerTitle: A sourced record is not automatically a payment record
transparency.explainerBody: Each entry keeps its agency, amount, period, status, location, and source together. Appropriations and procurement notices are displayed as published references; they do not prove municipal execution, final payment, or a contractor unless the source says so.
transparency.chartLabel: Transparency amounts in {{unit}}; use the data table below for exact values and sources.
transparency.tableCaption: Transparency records with exact values, context, and provenance.

gaps.financial: Audited municipal financial figures for CY 2024 are now published, taken from the Commission on Audit's Annual Audit Report. They are audited actuals for a closed year, not a current budget. National appropriation and procurement references are listed separately and do not prove municipal execution or payment.

statistics.explainerTitle: Metrics stay separate when their units differ
statistics.explainerBody: Choose one metric at a time. Population counts, household counts, and average household size have different meanings and must not be combined in a single series. Every value keeps its reference year, geography, and PSA source.
